bustouts: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (2 reviews): The reviewer notes Roses was being played for only the second time; The reviewer calls this probably their favorite version of Roses [17][19]
- **Instrumental Jam** (2 reviews): The closing jam on the soundcheck is called amazing, though the reviewer wishes it ran for hours; The final soundcheck jam is heard as resembling the Estimated Prophet chorus [19][25]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Cumberland Blues is described as blazing, and Jerry opens the second set with it [17]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Let It Grow is praised as growling, leaping and sailing [17]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Dark Star into Morning Dew runs about 45 minutes; Jerry takes 19 minutes to reach the first verse [23]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): Weather Report Suite is described as blistering and on time, with Billy driving the band [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **Part 1**: rare: 10 archived performances [28]
- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue**: back after 108 archived shows (516 days) [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-02-24.176221.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 216 min [1]
- **gd74-02-24.sbd.windsor.199.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 213 min; rated 4.62/5 by 78 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording is called excellent, with the second set seen as the essential part [23]
- **gd1974-02-24.sbd.marmar.13961.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 213 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1974-02-24.sbd.serafin.hollister.200.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 213 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Some very minor channel fading in a couple spots, plus a bit of digital noise just before Bertha or Big River [5]

## Around the show

- Let It Grow, They Love Each Other and U.S. Blues were soundchecked, either before this show or on 2/22/74 [3]
- The reviewer ranks this Dark Star among their top five ever and thinks it may be Billy's best performance [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-02-24.176221.sony.ecm250.falanga.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Louis Falanga; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Louis Falanga's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 250 mic > Sony TC-110 (Maxell UD C120) [1]. Also: A Sony ECM 22p source from Charles Connor supplies crowd sound and brief opening bits of several songs, including Brown Eyed Women and Jack Straw [1]
- **gd74-02-24.sbd.windsor.199.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: The complete show from the same lineage is available at gdlive.com; Individual songs came from GDLive; disc 4 track 1 was faulty, but that Dark Star is on this source. Discs 2 and 3 can be merged [18][22]
- **gd1974-02-24.sbd.marmar.13961.sbeok.flac16**: source: shntool fix of original Jay Serafin seed by marmar [4]. Also: Mr. Marmar processed the files with shntool to fix sector boundary errors and did the FLAC encoding in December 2002 [4]
- **gd1974-02-24.sbd.serafin.hollister.200.shnf**: transferred by Jay Serafin; source: SBD > FM > S:MR [5]
